description.sl: 25. aprila. Praznik miru in svobode: dedek Bepi pove, kako lepo je živeti v miru, nato gredo vsi skupaj na sprehod med pomladnimi rožami.
description.en: 25 April. A day of peace and freedom: Nonno Bepi says how good it is to live in peace, then everyone goes for a walk together among the spring flowers.
